settings.heading: Carved by Hands That Served Under This Flag.
settings.text:
After 22 years in the U.S. Army, I came home and couldn’t find a flag worth hanging. Everything in the stores was printed plastic with a “patriotic” label slapped on it — made anywhere but here.

So I went out to my garage, picked up a chisel, and carved my own. A neighbor asked for one. Then his brother. Then half the county.

Today, every carving still passes through my hands before it ships. I cut it, burn the detail in, seal it, and sign it — because the flag I served under deserves better than a factory line.

settings.title: My husband teared up. 26 years in the Corps.
settings.text: I bought this for my husband's retirement. He's not an emotional man. He held it for a long minute, ran his thumb over the eagle, and hung it over the fireplace himself that night. Worth every penny.
settings.name: Sarah K.

settings.question: Is it really handmade in the USA?
settings.answer: Yes — every single carving is cut, burned, sealed, and signed by our founder, a retired U.S. Army veteran, in his American workshop. Nothing is imported, outsourced, or printed. That's the whole point of this company.

settings.question: How big is it, and is it heavy?
settings.answer: Dimensions are listed above. It's solid hardwood, so it has real weight to it — that's the first thing people notice when they pick it up. Mounting hardware rated for the weight is included.

settings.question: How do I hang it?
settings.answer: It arrives ready to hang with keyhole mounts cut into the back and the hardware included. Most folks have it on the wall within five minutes of opening the box.

settings.question: How long until it arrives?
settings.answer: In-stock carvings ship within 1 business day, fully insured and free anywhere in the U.S. Most orders arrive in 3–5 business days. Made-to-order pieces show their build time above.

settings.question: Can I give it as a gift?
settings.answer: It's one of the most popular retirement, Veterans Day, and Father's Day gifts we know of. Add a note at checkout and we'll include a handwritten card — no prices on anything.

settings.question: What if I don't love it?
settings.answer: Send it back within 60 days for a full refund — we even cover the return shipping. It's a promise we can afford to make because returns almost never happen.
